_note: Site-day calendar on the Overview page (ADR 0102). One cell = one UTC day (24 hourly rows of data/ephem) at one site. Counting rule = data/overview.json (any part of the disc above the horizon used). pick_order = which hour of the day a cell opens on Compare: the middle hour of the day's longest stretch with both in view, else with the Sun, else with Earth (by disc centre where the day has such a stretch, so Compare gives the same answer), else fallback_hour. Changing pick_order or fallback_hour needs a rerun of scripts/calendar.mjs.
